# BillingScheduledChange

A downgrade or cancellation booked for the renewal, as the tenant sees it.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | [`ScheduledContractChangeKind`](scheduled-contract-change-kind.md) |  |
| `targetTier` | [`SkuTier`](sku-tier.md) |  |
| `targetCadence` | [`BillingCadence`](billing-cadence.md) |  |
| `targetLaneAddOns` | [`LaneAddOnQuantity`](lane-add-on-quantity.md)`[]` |  |
| `effectiveAtUtc` | `datetime` | When it takes effect (UTC). |

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "Downgrade",
  "targetTier": "Free",
  "targetCadence": "Monthly",
  "targetLaneAddOns": [
    {
      "lane": "Standard",
      "quantity": 0
    }
  ],
  "effectiveAtUtc": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`BillingStanding`](billing-standing.md)
